scripts.name: demo_plant_simulator
scripts.code: if (Math.random() < 0.1) { $setTag('motor3_running', !$getTag('motor3_running')); }$setTag('sensor3_active', $getTag('motor3_running'));var beltBase = $getTag('motor3_running') ? 1.2 : 0.4;$setTag('belt_speed', Math.max(0, beltBase + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.1));$setTag('motor_temp', Math.max(35, ($getTag('motor_temp')||46) + (Math.random()-0.5)*2));$setTag('units_produced', ($getTag('units_produced')||0) + ($getTag('motor3_running') ? Math.floor(Math.random()*3) : 0));$setTag('plant_uptime_pct', Math.min(100, Math.max(85, ($getTag('plant_uptime_pct')||97) + (Math.random()-0.5)*1.5)));$setTag('avg_cycle_time', Math.max(2.5, ($getTag('avg_cycle_time')||3.2) + (Math.random()-0.5)*0.3));$setTag('m1_hours', ($getTag('m1_hours')||0) + 0.02);$setTag('m2_hours', ($getTag('m2_hours')||0) + 0.02);if ($getTag('motor3_running')) { $setTag('m3_hours', ($getTag('m3_hours')||0) + 0.02); }
